production_managers.hero_sub: Production managers carry the weight of the entire operation. Pzaz gives you a central command layer — connected to every department, every schedule, and every budget.

prod_managers.hero_p: Keep schedules, teams and logistics aligned from prep to wrap. Production managers operate at the centre of every film, balancing schedules, budgets and coordination across departments while responding to constant change on set.
prod_managers.problem_title: Bring Structure to the Realities of
prod_managers.problem_desc: Managing a production involves juggling timelines, crew coordination and operational decisions that can shift quickly. When information is spread across spreadsheets, messaging threads and disconnected tools, small issues can escalate into delays.
prod_managers.problem_card_title: The friction that compounds across every production.
prod_managers.problem_item1: Schedules and logistics managed across disconnected tools
prod_managers.problem_item2: Crew availability and responsibilities hard to track centrally
prod_managers.problem_item3: Updates lost between departments, causing preventable delays
prod_managers.problem_item4: No single view of progress makes oversight difficult
prod_managers.problem_tagline: Pzaz helps production managers centralise planning and communication so that updates remain visible, responsibilities stay clear and the overall workflow becomes easier to manage under pressure.
prod_managers.promise_h2: More Control Over What Happens Next.
prod_managers.promise_p: Pzaz provides production managers with a centralised environment where schedules, crew and tasks remain visible and adjustable in real time — so the production keeps moving even when plans change.
prod_managers.tools_desc: Support every dimension of production management. Scheduling, coordination, task tracking and document access — all in one connected environment.
prod_managers.tool1_desc: Detailed calendars and shooting schedules can be created and adjusted within a single environment, allowing changes to be reflected across departments without repeated manual updates.
prod_managers.tool2_desc: Production teams can track roles, availability and key details for both crew and cast, helping ensure that logistical decisions are based on accurate, accessible information.
prod_managers.tool2_highlight: Maintain oversight of availability and responsibilities.
prod_managers.tool3_desc: Visual task boards provide a practical way to assign work, monitor progress and adjust priorities as production needs evolve.
prod_managers.tool4_desc: Scripts, call sheets and other production documents can be stored and shared securely, reducing the time spent searching for critical information.
prod_managers.cta_h2: Ready to Run Your Production with Greater Confidence?
prod_managers.cta_p: Give your production the clarity it needs. Schedules, crew and communication — all in one place.
